# Gillani Group

> Gillani Group (GILLANI GROUP S.R.L.) is a European group of companies registered in Romania in 2026. It works in wholesale trade and online retail with its own brands Regal Wear (fashion) and Home Bohemia (home décor), and is preparing a recruitment division (placement licence from ANOFM in progress; no placement services are offered yet).

## Key facts

- Legal name: GILLANI GROUP S.R.L. (limited liability company, Romania)
- CUI (tax ID): 55657777
- Trade Register number: J2026056523005
- EUID: ROONRC.J2026056523005
- Registered office: Str. Florilor, Bl. 1, Sc. 1, Ap. 22, Oraș Bălan, Jud. Harghita, Romania
- Founder and administrator: Sheharyar
- Founded: 2026
- Main activity (CAEN): 7810 workforce placement; also 7820 temporary staffing, 4690 non-specialised wholesale, 4619 trade intermediation, 4791 online retail
- Area served: Romania and the European Union
- Languages: English, Romanian, German (website); English, Romanian, Urdu (customer contact)
- Phone and WhatsApp: +40 773 752 078
- Email: admin@gillanigroup.eu
- Website: https://gillanigroup.eu

## Divisions

- [Trade & E-commerce](https://gillanigroup.eu/trade.html): wholesale supply to retailers and businesses, sourcing and trade intermediation, and online sales through own stores, including Home Bohemia (https://homebohemia.eu), a home décor store. The online stores currently work with international suppliers and fulfilment partners; the company is building a supply network with EU wholesalers and brand distributors.
- [Fashion Brands](https://gillanigroup.eu/fashion.html): online fashion store Regal Wear (https://regalwear.eu), with curated clothing and accessories for customers across Europe; Fashion Prestige is a second store in preparation.
- [Recruitment](https://gillanigroup.eu/recruitment.html): coming soon. The company is obtaining authorisation as a workforce placement agency from ANOFM (required by Romania's OUG 32/2026). Until then it does not place workers; employers can only register their interest.

## Vision and goals

Vision: to become a trusted European group of companies, known for genuine products, fair recruitment and long-term partnerships.
Goals: grow its own online stores and sell on marketplaces such as Amazon and eMAG; build a supply network with wholesalers and brand distributors in the EU; fair and legal recruitment once licensed; one trusted group with clear terms.

- [Good news for hiring foreign workers in Romania: 7 positive developments (October 2026)](https://gillanigroup.eu/blog-good-news-hiring-foreign-workers-romania.html): Ministry of Labour appeal, pending applications still reviewed, D/AM1 and D/DT routes open, simpler rules under review, first ANOFM-authorised agencies, regularisation, and continued demand for workers.
- [Labour shortages in Europe, autumn 2026: what the latest figures say](https://gillanigroup.eu/blog-labour-shortage-europe-autumn-2026.html): EU, Germany and Romania labour shortage data, Romania's 2026 quota of 90,000 non-EU workers and the most needed occupations.
- [Hiring non-EU workers in Romania in 2026: what changed with OUG 32/2026](https://gillanigroup.eu/blog-hiring-non-eu-workers-romania-2026.html): the single application on WorkinRomania.gov.ro, D/AM1 and D/AM2 visas, employer and agency rules.
